Browser-robustness mock sites

Each page simulates a real-world website behavior for testing NixClaw's browser tools.

Captcha

  • /captcha-grid — image-grid captcha (select the red circles)
  • /captcha-text — canvas-rendered text captcha

Cookie banners

  • /cookie-simple — bottom banner, single Accept button
  • /cookie-modal — full-screen consent modal
  • /cookie-nested — consent hidden behind a settings sub-dialog
  • /cookie-delayed — banner slides in 3s after load

Quirks

  • /quirk-404 — pretty page served with HTTP 404
  • /quirk-jsonly — empty shell, content rendered by JS
  • /quirk-scroll — infinite scroll, target on page 5
  • /quirk-redirect — meta-refresh + JS redirect chain
  • /quirk-popup — newsletter modal appears after 2s
  • /quirk-paywall — article teaser behind a subscribe wall
  • /quirk-ua — blocks headless user agents with HTTP 403
  • /quirk-longpoll — network never goes idle
  • /quirk-huge — page far beyond snapshot truncation limit
  • /quirk-iframe — main content inside an iframe

Slow

  • /slow-server — server holds the response for 20s
  • /slow-ajax — instant shell, content arrives via 8s AJAX call
